description: Traffic Counter Locations is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Infrastructure Ireland. TII operates and maintains a network of traffic counters on the national primary and secondary road network in Ireland. There are currently almost 300 of these counters active across the network. For an interactive view of the data they capture, go to the TII Traffic Counter Data Website nratrafficdata.ie. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Infrastructure Ireland. Its tags are Traffic, roads-traffic, traffic infrastructure, traffic-counts, traffic-management. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, SHAPE FILE, TAB SEPARATED VALUES. The portal shows 2018-03-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
